# HEXOR_8

> Portfolio and commission site for HEXOR_8, an anime edit / motion graphics / video editor. A single scrolling page covering portfolio work and how to commission custom work.

## Sections
- Hero: introduction and quick links to the portfolio and the commission section
- Watch My Stuff: entry point to the three portfolio categories below
- Anime Edits: AMV-style anime edits, linked from the creator's YouTube channel
- Talking-Head Videos: commentary/talking-head video editing samples
- GFX: banners/headers and thumbnail design work
- My Story: background on the creator and how they got into editing
- Tools: software used (DaVinci Resolve 21, Blender)
- Find Me: social links (YouTube, Instagram, Discord)
- Scraps: small bonus section for unfinished experiments
- Hire Me: how commissions work, pricing terms, and a commission request form

## Contact

- Instagram: https://instagram.com/hexor_8
